ice.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production pixel-art modular sprite kit for Bullets of Fury. Design a NEW stage 3 ICE miniboss, visibly distinct from a pointed ice fighter: a broad squared-off hovering Arctic siege carrier, twin chunky cylindrical cryogenic laser cannons on detachable side pivots, armored horizontal crossbar silhouette, navy gunmetal, pale silver edges, cyan ice cores. True high-detail Neo-Geo / HD arcade sprite clusters, crisp outlines, NO smooth 3D render. Direct orthographic overhead top view, nose and both cannon muzzles aimed straight DOWN the image toward the player, NO isometric perspective. It must stay modular: do not bake guns into the bare central hull. One transparent 1536x1024 canvas, exactly six separate parts arranged in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512x512 with 40px clear gutter, no labels. Top row: 1) bare wide main hull with two EMPTY side cannon sockets and no integrated guns, 2) separate LEFT long cryo cannon and its circular mounting joint, 3) separate RIGHT matching cryo cannon and circular mounting joint. Bottom row: 4) detached central circular frost reactor fitting the hull socket, 5) separate LEFT small missile pod, 6) separate RIGHT missile pod. All parts at one consistent scale and orientation. Hull fills first cell to maximum 432x360, others remain sized to assemble on that hull naturally. Solid machinery fully opaque, only background transparent; no floating frost mist, no scenery, no shadows, no effects crossing between cells. The surface detail, functional gun barrels and metallic palette should match an exceptionally good classic arcade shoot-em-up. This is an in-game kit, not a poster.

hammer.prompt: Edit target / identity reference: the attached actual Bullets of Fury Hammer Boss sprite. Generate one production sprite animation sheet with EXACTLY 16 distinct hand-drawn poses, a strict 4 by 4 grid on transparent background, equal square cells, no titles or labels. Same chrome-black armored two-armed robot, two legs, ONE blue chromium hammer, blue eyes, SAME circular blue reactor physically built INTO his chest. Never add an arm, separate chest disc, duplicate head, or a second weapon. Same front three-quarter pose and proportions, crisp high-detail Neo-Geo HD arcade pixel clusters, no blur. Each full figure fits its cell with a large clear margin. Common scale and chest center anchor in every cell; no shrinking or shifting. Frames 1-8 top two rows: idle cycle with very subtle mechanical articulation and the INTERNAL CHEST REACTOR rotating/pulsing from deep blue through brilliant white-blue then back; hammer stays held down to his left. Frames 9-16 bottom two rows: clear continuous wind-up, both actual attached arms lift the SAME hammer from low left through shoulder height to high overhead, then hold the overhead pose as electricity fills ONLY the hammer glass and chest reactor. Feet and torso stay centered throughout, same two arms with both hands visibly gripping ONE handle. Keep the full blade/hammer/feet well inside each equal cell. No halos or surrounding effects outside the silhouette; transparent RGBA background, solid opaque mechanical subject. This is a complete 16-pose animation, not sixteen redesigns. Reference frame and all new frames must share the same robot design.
